title: Insuppressible  "No GDExtension library found for current OS and architecture" Errors in the editor when developing for a different OS
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.3, 4.4, 4.4.1

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.4.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) - Apple M1 Pro (8 threads)

### Issue description

When developing or using a GDExtension that's only meant to be used on another OS (iOS in this case) the editor keeps spamming these errors 

```  ERROR: core/extension/gdextension_library_loader.cpp:359 - No GDExtension library found for current OS and architecture (macos.arm64) in configuration file: res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension
  ERROR: GDExtension dynamic library not found: 'res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension'.
  ERROR: core/extension/gdextension_library_loader.cpp:359 - No GDExtension library found for current OS and architecture (macos.arm64) in configuration file: res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension
  ERROR: GDExtension dynamic library not found: 'res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension'.
  ERROR: core/extension/gdextension_library_loader.cpp:359 - No GDExtension library found for current OS and architecture (macos.arm64) in configuration file: res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension
  ERROR: GDExtension dynamic library not found: 'res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension'.
  ERROR: core/extension/gdextension_library_loader.cpp:359 - No GDExtension library found for current OS and architecture (macos.arm64) in configuration file: res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension
  ERROR: GDExtension dynamic library not found: 'res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension'.
  ERROR: core/extension/gdextension_library_loader.cpp:359 - No GDExtension library found for current OS and architecture (macos.arm64) in configuration file: res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension
  ERROR: GDExtension dynamic library not found: 'res://bin/inapppurchase.gdextension'.
```


In this case I'm using an extension for In App Purchases on iOS which will never trigger on Mac / Windows while developing the game and testing it. The only way to suppress the warnings is to build and include the libs for the development system (I assume including a dummy lib will also work). I expect there to be a way to tell the code that loads the extension to ignore the current OS that's used for development

### Steps to reproduce

create a `.gdextension` file that doesn't have the development system in it

```[configuration]
entry_symbol = "inapppurchase"
compatibility_minimum = 4.2
relodable = true

[libraries]
ios.release = "res://bin/InAppPurchase.framework"


[dependencies]
ios.release = {"res://bin/SwiftGodot.framework" : ""}

```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Since it can be reproduced by writing a single file, there is no need for a MRP
